implementations.label: step_glyph (substrate/core.py)
implementations.function_body:
def step_glyph(substrate: Substrate, seed: Seed, position: int = 0, temperature: float = 0.8,
               goal_seed: Optional[Seed] = None, goal_step: float = 0.05) -> GlyphState:
    scores = seed.vector @ substrate.basis.T
    scores = scores / max(temperature, 0.1)
    scores = scores - scores.max()
    probs = np.exp(scores) / np.exp(scores).sum()
    basis_idx = int(np.random.choice(substrate.K, p=probs))
    word = VOCAB_LANES[position % 4][basis_idx % 64]
    new_vec = seed.vector + 0.1 * substrate.basis[basis_idx]
    new_vec = new_vec / (np.linalg.norm(new_vec) + 1e-8)
    new_seed = Seed(vector=new_vec.astype(np.float32), depth=seed.depth, entropy=seed.entropy,
                    metadata={**seed.metadata, 'last_basis_idx': basis_idx})
    if goal_seed is not None:
        new_seed = gradient_toward(new_seed, goal_seed, step_size=goal_step)
    return GlyphState(seed=new_seed, basis_idx=basis_idx, word=word, position=position)
implementations.recurrence: h' = normalize(h + 0.1 * B[idx]), idx ~ Cat(softmax(h @ B.T / τ))
outputs: GlyphState (new seed [D], basis_idx int, word str, position int)
